## 描述 / Description

简要描述这个 PR 做了什么 / Brief description of what this PR does.

## 变更类型 / Type of Change

请删除不适用的选项 / Please delete options that are not relevant.

- [ ] Bug 修复 / Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] 新功能 / New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 破坏性变更 / Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 文档更新 / Documentation update

## 相关 Issue / Related Issues

关联的 Issue 编号 / Fixes # (issue number)

## 变更内容 / Changes Made

- 变更 1 / Change 1
- 变更 2 / Change 2
- ...

## 测试说明 / How Has This Been Tested?

请描述你如何测试了这些变更 / Please describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes.

- [ ] 测试 A / Test A
- [ ] 测试 B / Test B

## 截图（如适用）/ Screenshots (if applicable)

如果有 UI 变更，请添加截图 / If there are UI changes, please add screenshots.

## 检查清单 / Checklist

- [ ] 我的代码遵循项目的代码规范 / My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] 我已经进行了自我代码审查 / I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] 我已经添加了必要的注释 / I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] 我已经更新了相关文档 / I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] 我的变更没有产生新的警告 / My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] 我已经添加了测试来验证我的修复或功能 / I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] 新的和现有的单元测试都通过了 / New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
